summary: Gathio is a self-hosted tool for organising temporary events through shareable web pages. It lets you spin up registration-free pages that are designed to disappear after use. The application runs on Node.js and is packaged for containerised environments.
goodFor: It is a good fit if you need to coordinate ad hoc gatherings without forcing participants to create accounts or hand over personal data.
watchOut: With a modest community following and moderate maintenance activity, you may need to patch bugs yourself or rely on a small contributor base for long-term updates.
deployNotes: Because it runs as a Docker container, you will typically need to configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and ensure any necessary data volumes are mounted persistently.
